value_observation: Every recorded first read before a write has value undefined, never null. First means the first read in each epoch following a placeholder initializer or reset, not merely the first read in the process. Locations are aggregated and do not establish temporal order between epochs.
method: Reuses the pinned 301-project Node observations without rerunning the projects. Checks each inspected stock source file against files.json; classifications and downstream-use explanations are source inspection, not new runtime observations.
limits: Does not prove safety for inputs outside the 301 measured projects.
Does not observe every subsequent consumer of an undefined value.
After-write means a write occurred, not that the written value was nonnull; node.symbol at nodeFactory.ts:1309 also has after-write undefined observations.
ruling_question: Should an unset placeholder be observable as undefined in presence tests and be transferable through saves/restores, clones and optional helper parameters? The current stop-on-every-first-read rule stops all 19 on measured inputs; permitting only direct presence tests does not cover the recorded transport uses. Typed dereferences and calls must still require readiness. No compiler policy change is made by this table.
